title: Idea-count gaming: 100 'unique' ideas that are wording variants
question: When a brainstorm is told to reach 100 unique ideas, does the uniqueness gate reject trivial rewordings, one-parameter forks and renamed duplicates - and what is its measured discrimination?
answer: No. On this worktree tools/council/quota/unique_ideas.py is absent and CouncilSpec unique_idea targets are skipped by tools/council/quota/targets.py, so the live uniqueness surface accepts every planted mutant class (exact rename, synonym swap, one-parameter fork, reordered composition) and also accepts the genuinely distinct idea. Gaming-class recall is 0.0. Probe 2's mechanism space rejects the four variant classes and accepts the distinct idea; lexical Jaccard catches near-copies and misses synonym swap. This unit does not implement IMP-0300.
sentinel: SUCCESS:ADV-0096 emitted ONLY when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, records BOTH named probes verbatim with their raw output, carries exactly one verdict from {CONFIRMED|REFUTED|PARTIAL|NOT-CHECKED|BLOCKED} per enumerated target, and records the result of every listed control/negative test. Any missing control downgrades the unit's verdicts to NOT-CHECKED. Otherwise FAILED:ADV-0096 <reason>.

Any missing control downgrades the unit's verdicts to NOT-CHECKED. Otherwise FAILED:ADV-0096 <reason>.
schema_note: command-center/schema/council-pathology-sim.schema.json exists. Artifact is JSON, carries the catalog completion sentinel, both named probes verbatim with raw output, closed-set verdicts, and the required distinct-idea plus reject-all controls.

reviewer.note: Catalog asked for two reviewers from different vendors. This tree does not invoke a second vendor model. Probe 2 is a mechanically different instrument (canonical-mechanism space vs live-gate matrix), not a second vendor vote.

mechanism: planted mutant-class matrix evaluated on the live uniqueness surface plus a second non-lexical similarity space
not_a_duplicate_because: the same anti-padding problem this catalog itself is subject to; ADV-0114 applies the collapse check to SYNTHESIS output, where the population and the consequences differ.
